Prefill workers of PD disaggregation only. + Shard at-rest KV cache storage at page granularity across the group that currently replicates it (attention-CP ranks for GQA models under prefill CP; attention-TP ranks for MLA models), multiplying the group's unique KV capacity. Prefill workers of PD disaggregation only. With NCCL 2.29.2 or newer and supported NVIDIA CUDA hardware, eligible single-node shard groups request zero-SM copy-engine prefix all-gather on a dedicated NCCL communicator. This path needs cuMem-backed NCCL memory, so on single-node deployments the server sets NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 for every NCCL communicator of all server processes unless NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE is already set; it does not under --enable-memory-saver or SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL, which keep the SM-kernel all-gather. Multi-node deployments keep NCCL's setting (MNNVL fabrics default it to 1); export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 there to use this path for shard groups within one node. Set SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER=0 to disable this path. Leave NCCL_CTA_POLICY unset: a global value overrides both the gather communicator's zero-SM policy and the default policy of forward collectives. SGLANG_KV_SHARD_GATHER_TRANSPORT=multicast or unicast replaces the NCCL all-gather with copy-engine pushes into the scratch window (multicast also sets NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1 for every NCCL communicator unless it is already set), and SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_GATHER_PAUSE=1 lets the forward's collectives pause those pushes. `False` bool flag (set to enable)

On single-node deployments this also makes the server set NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1 for every NCCL communicator unless it is already set, except under --enable-memory-saver or SGLANG_MOONCAKE_CUSTOM_MEM_POOL; see --enable-kv-cache-sharding for the full conditions. Set to false to keep the SM-kernel all-gather and the default NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=0. + true + + + SGLANG_KV_SHARD_GATHER_TRANSPORT + Transport of the KV-shard prefix gather on the symmetric scratch: nccl (the NCCL all-gather), multicast (each rank pushes its block with copy-engine copies through the window's NVLS multicast address; the server then sets NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1 for every NCCL communicator unless it is already set) or unicast (copy-engine pushes into every peer's window; no NVLS needed). A push transport that cannot reach every rank falls back to nccl with a warning. + nccl + + + SGLANG_KV_SHARD_GATHER_CHUNK_MB + Chunk size of the multicast / unicast prefix gather. Smaller chunks let a pause land sooner; larger chunks cost less per byte. 0 sends each block in one copy (and disables the pause). + 8 + + + SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_GATHER_PAUSE + With the multicast / unicast prefix gather, run its chunks behind the NVLink transfer gate so the forward's all-reduces and all-gathers pause it at the next chunk boundary. Opt-in: a parked chunk stalls every stream that shares its CUDA hardware queue (raise CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS, which the server keeps when above 8); a pause stuck behind one is broken only by SGLANG_GATED_TRANSFER_WATCHDOG_MS. + false + + + SGLANG_GATED_TRANSFER_WATCHDOG_MS + Gated background transfers: force open a transfer gate whose pause has been held this many milliseconds, and log an error. A pause that never resumes means work the resume depends on is stuck behind a parked chunk (a hardware queue shared with it, a lazy module load or a device sync inside a pause); the transfer then overlaps the foreground op instead of hanging it. 0 disables the watchdog. + 1000 +

@@ -0,0 +1,820 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Gated background transfers: pause any chunked transfer for foreground ops.
+
+A background bulk transfer that overlaps the forward (a KV-cache gather over
+NVLink, host <-> device copies over PCIe) slows any latency-critical op that
+shares its link, and nothing preempts work already on the GPU. A
+``TransferChain`` runs a transfer as chunks that each wait on its link's
+pause word, so a foreground bracket stops every transfer on the link at the
+next chunk boundary and restarts it without resubmitting anything::
+
+    chain = TransferChain(Link.PCIE_H2D)  # once per owner, on its device
+    landed = chain.run(copy_chunks(dst, src, 16 << 20))  # returns at once
+    ...
+    with paused_background_transfers(Link.PCIE_H2D):
+        latency_critical_op()  # the chunks wait at their next boundary
+    ...
+    chain.wait(landed)  # the current stream waits for the transfer to land
+
+A chunk is any callable ``chunk(stream)`` (``ChunkOp``), run with ``stream``
+current: it may enqueue its work through any API that uses the current
+stream (``tensor.copy_``, ``PyNcclCommunicator`` calls, the HiCache transfer
+kernels) or through ``stream`` itself, and ``copy_chunks`` builds copy-engine
+chunks. A chunk may run after ``run`` returned, on the chain's feeder thread
+(below), so it must not depend on state its caller scopes around ``run``
+(a chunk calling NCCL enters ``change_state`` itself). It must not allocate,
+sync or wait on the host, since it may be enqueued behind a paused gate, and
+should enqueue little (a copy, a collective): the chain bounds the ops it
+keeps queued, not what each one enqueues. The chunk size bounds how long a
+pause takes to land. Chunks that are NCCL calls
+pause only this rank's side: a peer whose chunk already passed its gate
+waits inside NCCL for the whole pause (on SMs for kernel collectives), so
+prefer copy-engine collectives, small chunks, and a communicator no
+foreground op uses (NCCL orders every op of a communicator).
+
+How it works:
+- Gate: one pause word per link and device, in pinned, device-mapped host
+  memory. A bracket writes a fresh nonzero sequence number to pause and 0 to
+  resume, with ``cuStreamWriteValue32`` in the order of the bracketed op's
+  stream. Only the thread that paused a gate resumes it; a bracket on
+  another thread leaves that gate alone. A bracket pauses only gates on the
+  current device with a run that has not landed. A run issued once the
+  bracketed op is enqueued, after the bracketing stream (the default
+  ``after``), starts behind the op; a run issued meanwhile from another
+  thread, or after another stream, may overlap a bracket that found its gate
+  drained.
+- Chain: a stream may evaluate a wait ahead of the work queued before it,
+  which would let several chunks pass their gates before a pause lands.
+  Chunks alternate between the chain's two streams and each waits for an
+  event of the op before it (the first chunk of a run: its setup ops and the
+  whole previous run), so a gate is read only once the work before it
+  retired and at most one chunk per chain drains after a pause. The chain
+  creates its streams (``cuStreamCreate``; a pooled ``torch.cuda.Stream`` may
+  be the forward's own stream) and never destroys them: torch may still
+  record events on a stream a chunk used (freeing a pinned block a
+  ``tensor.copy_`` used), so a chain lives as long as the process.
+- Submission: a chain keeps at most ``_WINDOW`` ops queued on the GPU, since
+  a stream queue full of chunks parked behind a pause blocks the thread
+  that enqueues more. ``run`` enqueues at most a window of ops itself, and
+  the chain's feeder thread enqueues the rest, in order, as earlier ops
+  retire: ``run`` never waits for the GPU, and does not push back on a
+  caller that outruns its link either (its runs queue up on the host).
+  After a run's last op the GPU writes the run's ticket to a host-mapped
+  word, which ``query`` reads. ``wait`` makes a stream wait for it only
+  once the whole run is enqueued: a stream waiting on work not enqueued yet
+  can hold a hardware queue, or the driver, that the rest of the run needs.
+  So ``wait`` blocks the host while a run longer than the window is still
+  queued, behind a pause or a busy link: issue whatever its ops wait on
+  first. If the chain's own driver calls fail, it fails for good: its
+  pending runs are dropped and raise instead of landing.
+
+Hazards: a parked gate wait holds its stream's hardware queue, and later
+work of every stream mapped to that queue (``CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS``)
+stalls behind it. Anything the resume depends on that lands behind a parked
+wait hangs the forward: the bracketing stream (or a peer's stream its
+collective needs) sharing a hardware queue with a parked wait, a lazy module
+load (a kernel's first launch, an NCCL lazy connect) or a device-wide sync
+(``cudaFree`` when an allocation misses the cache) inside a bracket, or a
+stream waiting on the paused transfer inside the bracket (``wait`` refuses
+that on the pausing thread). So bracket only the communication call, after
+its outputs exist. A watchdog thread (``SGLANG_GATED_TRANSFER_WATCHDOG_MS``)
+forces open, with a host store, a gate whose same pause has been held that
+long, and logs it: the transfer then overlaps the foreground op, a slowdown
+instead of a hang.
+
+Brackets are eager-only: no-ops under ``torch.compile`` tracing and stream
+capture. Chains refuse capture (a captured chain loses the drain bound).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections
+import ctypes
+import enum
+import functools
+import logging
+import threading
+import time
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from typing import Callable, Deque, List, NoReturn, Optional, Sequence, Tuple, Union
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils.cuda_vmm_utils import check_drv
+
+try:
+    from cuda.bindings import driver as cu
+except ImportError:  # a build without cuda-python: no transfer can run
+    cu = None
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# cuda.h CUstreamWaitValue_flags: EQ, and GEQ ((int32_t)(*addr - value) >= 0).
+_WAIT_EQ = 0x1
+_WAIT_GEQ = 0x0
+# Ops a chain keeps queued on the GPU. Its streams take about a thousand
+# single-copy chunks before enqueueing more blocks the host (B200); this
+# leaves room for chunks that enqueue more work. Arbitrary below that.
+_WINDOW = 64
+
+
+class Link(enum.Flag):
+    """The interconnect a transfer loads. PCIe is full duplex, so each
+    direction is its own link."""
+
+    NVLINK = 1
+    PCIE_H2D = 2
+    PCIE_D2H = 4
+    PCIE = PCIE_H2D | PCIE_D2H
+
+
+# One chunk of a background transfer: enqueues its work on the given stream,
+# which is also current while it runs.
+ChunkOp = Callable[[torch.cuda.Stream], None]
+
+
+def _create_event(blocking: bool = False):
+    flags = cu.CUevent_flags.CU_EVENT_DISABLE_TIMING
+    if blocking:  # a host wait sleeps instead of spinning a core
+        flags |= cu.CUevent_flags.CU_EVENT_BLOCKING_SYNC
+    return check_drv(cu.cuEventCreate(flags), "cuEventCreate")
+
+
+def _relax_capture_mode():
+    """Let this thread query and wait on events while another thread runs a
+    global-mode capture, which those calls would otherwise invalidate.
+    Returns the previous mode."""
+    return check_drv(
+        cu.cuThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode(
+            cu.CUstreamCaptureMode.CU_STREAM_CAPTURE_MODE_RELAXED
+        ),
+        "capture mode",
+    )
+
+
+def _event_done(event) -> bool:
+    mode = _relax_capture_mode()
+    try:
+        result = cu.cuEventQuery(event)
+        if result[0] == cu.CUresult.CUDA_ERROR_NOT_READY:
+            return False
+        check_drv(result, "cuEventQuery")
+        return True
+    finally:
+        cu.cuThreadExchangeStreamCaptureMode(mode)
+
+
+def _reached(ticket: int, target: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether the 32-bit run ticket ``ticket`` is at or past ``target``."""
+    return (ticket - target) & 0xFFFFFFFF < 0x80000000
+
+
+def _bind_context(device: int) -> None:
+    """Make ``device``'s primary context current if this thread has none:
+    torch binds it at a thread's first runtime call, and a driver call here
+    may come first."""
+    result = cu.cuCtxGetCurrent()
+    if not result[0] and int(result[1]):
+        return
+    check_drv(result, "cuCtxGetCurrent")
+    handle = check_drv(cu.cuDeviceGet(device), "cuDeviceGet")
+    context = check_drv(cu.cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain(handle), "cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain")
+    check_drv(cu.cuCtxSetCurrent(context), "cuCtxSetCurrent")
+
+
+def _host_word() -> Tuple[ctypes.c_uint32, int]:
+    """A zeroed uint32 in pinned, device-mapped host memory, never freed, and
+    its device address: streams wait on it or write it, the host reads or
+    writes it directly. Needs the device's context current."""
+    host = check_drv(
+        cu.cuMemHostAlloc(
+            64, cu.CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_PORTABLE | cu.CU_MEMHOSTALLOC_DEVICEMAP
+        ),
+        "cuMemHostAlloc",
+    )
+    address = check_drv(
+        cu.cuMemHostGetDevicePointer(host, 0), "cuMemHostGetDevicePointer"
+    )
+    word = ctypes.c_uint32.from_address(host)
+    word.value = 0
+    return word, int(address)
+
+
+# ---- gates --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Gate:
+    """The pause word of one link's chains on one device."""
+
+    def __init__(self, link: Link, device: int):
+        self.link = link
+        self.device = device
+        # The watchdog opens it with a plain host store.
+        self._word, self.address = _host_word()
+        self._seq = 0
+        # Replaced, never mutated: brackets read it without the lock.
+        self._chains: Tuple[TransferChain, ...] = ()
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        # The bracket that paused the gate: its thread resumes it, on the
+        # stream that paused it.
+        self._pause_thread: Optional[int] = None
+        self._pause_stream: Optional[torch.cuda.Stream] = None
+        # Watchdog: (sequence number, first seen at) of a held pause.
+        self._held: Optional[Tuple[int, float]] = None
+        self.forced_opens = 0
+
+    def pause(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        """Stop the chunks at their next boundary, in ``stream`` order. Each
+        pause writes a fresh nonzero sequence number."""
+        self._seq = self._seq % 0xFFFFFFFF + 1
+        self._write(self._seq, stream)
+
+    def resume(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        self._write(0, stream)
+
+    def _write(self, value: int, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        # Flags 0 keep the memory barrier; NO_MEMORY_BARRIER is rejected on
+        # B200 / driver 13.4.
+        check_drv(
+            cu.cuStreamWriteValue32(stream.cuda_stream, self.address, value, 0),
+            "pause word (cuStreamWriteValue32)",
+        )
+
+    def word(self) -> int:
+        """The pause word as the GPU last wrote it (0: open)."""
+        return self._word.value
+
+    def force_open(self) -> None:
+        """Open the gate from the host, behind every stream's back."""
+        self._word.value = 0
+
+    def busy(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether a chain on this gate has a run that has not landed."""
+        for chain in self._chains:
+            if chain._landed.value != chain._issued:
+                return True
+        return False
+
+
+# Brackets and the watchdog iterate this tuple without the lock; it is
+# replaced, never mutated.
+_gates: Tuple[_Gate, ...] = ()
+_registry_lock = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def _add_chain(link: Link, device: int, chain: TransferChain) -> _Gate:
+    """The gate of ``link`` on ``device``, created on first use, with
+    ``chain`` added to it."""
+    global _gates
+    with _registry_lock:
+        gate = next((g for g in _gates if g.link == link and g.device == device), None)
+        if gate is None:
+            gate = _Gate(link, device)
+            _gates = _gates + (gate,)
+            _start_watchdog()
+        gate._chains = gate._chains + (chain,)
+        return gate
+
+
+# ---- watchdog -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_watchdog: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
+
+
+def _watchdog_timeout_s() -> float:
+    from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+    return envs.SGLANG_GATED_TRANSFER_WATCHDOG_MS.get() / 1000.0
+
+
+def _start_watchdog() -> None:
+    global _watchdog
+    if _watchdog is None and _watchdog_timeout_s() > 0:
+        _watchdog = threading.Thread(
+            target=_watch_gates, name="gated-transfer-watchdog", daemon=True
+        )
+        _watchdog.start()
+
+
+def _watch_gates() -> None:
+    """Force open any gate whose same pause has been held for the timeout.
+    Every hang a pause can cause holds its sequence number forever, while a
+    resumed pause gives way to 0 within one foreground op."""
+    while True:
+        timeout = _watchdog_timeout_s()
+        if timeout <= 0:
+            return
+        time.sleep(max(timeout / 4, 0.001))
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        for gate in _gates:
+            _check_held(gate, now, timeout)
+
+
+def _check_held(gate: _Gate, now: float, timeout: float) -> bool:
+    """One watchdog sample of ``gate``; True if it forced the gate open."""
+    seq = gate.word()
+    held = gate._held

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""One-sided, zero-SM allgather and broadcast over an NCCL symmetric window.
+
+A rank pushes its data into the output on its peers with copy-engine copies,
+through one of two kinds of target addresses into the window (identical
+offsets on every rank):
+
+- multicast: the window's NVLS multicast VA; one copy reaches every rank's
+  backing memory, so a rank's NVLink egress is 1x what it sends, not (N-1)x;
+- unicast: each peer's window, mapped through NCCL's LSA team; one copy per
+  peer (rotating peers, one copy per gated chunk), no NVLS needed.
+
+- ``SymmetricAllGather``: every rank pushes its own block into its slot.
+- ``SymmetricBroadcast``: the root pushes its buffer; the others only sync.
+
+No SM runs and no NCCL collective is involved: the data copies are chunk ops
+(``gated_transfer.CopyChunk``), so a gated ``TransferChain`` can pause them,
+and the only two-sided step is the barrier pair around them, never gated:
+
+- entry, on the chain: every rank's output is free to be overwritten (each
+  rank's previous readers are ordered before its signal by the chain's
+  ``after`` stream);
+- exit: the chain signals it once this rank's copies have landed, and the
+  consumer waits for every rank's signal on its own stream (``wait``), so a
+  reader ordered after ``wait`` on any rank sees the full output.
+
+A barrier (``WindowBarrier``) is a 4-byte copy-engine copy of the constant 1
+into this rank's lane through every target, then one batch of stream memops on
+the LOCAL lanes: wait until every lane is 1, then clear every lane. Stream
+memops are rejected on multicast VAs, so only a copy can signal. The entry and
+exit barriers alternate between two lane arrays: reusing one array back to
+back would let a fast rank's next signal land before a slow rank's clear and
+be lost.
+
+A paused rank holds every peer's readers until it resumes (its exit signal
+follows its last chunk). The exit wait sits on the consumer's stream, at its
+read point, not on the chain: no chain stream ever parks on a peer, so a
+peer's lazy module load, device sync or shared hardware queue cannot hold
+back the collective that the paused rank's resume waits on (the peer issued
+that collective before its read). The entry wait only waits on work every
+rank submitted earlier, so a shared hardware queue costs overlap but cannot
+deadlock it.
+
+Even unpaused, a long unbroken multicast copy starves concurrent NVLink
+collectives (measured on 8x B200: a 32 MiB fused all-reduce 110 -> 960 us),
+which chunking alone reduces (-> ~250-350 us) and pausing removes (-> 114 us).
+
+Layout contract: the output is ``window[off : off + size]`` at an offset
+identical on every rank (an allgather's rank r slot at ``off + r * block``).
+The control region (``control_bytes(world_size)``) is carved out of the same
+window at an offset identical on every rank and must be zeroed on every rank
+before any rank's first call (``init_control``, a device sync, then a host
+barrier). Transfers sharing one barrier must be issued in the same order on
+every rank and run on one chain, and each must be consumed (``wait``) on a
+stream that the next transfer's ``after`` stream is ordered behind; a
+transfer issued while the previous one is unconsumed consumes it on its own
+``after`` stream first.

+    return (value + alignment - 1) // alignment * alignment

+    """Two lane arrays and the constant 1 that signals copy from, each on its

+class WindowBarrier:
+    """Entry / exit barrier of the symmetric transfers over one window.
+
+    ``targets``: the base addresses through which a copy reaches the window
+    at the same offset on every rank: ``[multicast_base]``, or every rank's
+    window base (this rank's local base included).

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        rank: int,
+        world_size: int,
+        local_base: int,
+        targets: Sequence[int],
+        control_offset: int,
+    ):
+        assert 0 <= rank < world_size
+        assert targets and all(targets), "a window target is NULL (NVLS off?)"
+        assert len(targets) in (1, world_size)
+        assert 2 * world_size <= _MAX_BATCH_MEM_OPS
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.world_size = world_size
+        self.local_base = local_base
+        self.targets = tuple(targets)
+        # Unicast: one target per rank, indexed by rank. Multicast: one.
+        self.unicast = len(self.targets) > 1

+        lane_stride = _align_up(world_size * _U32, _LINE)
+        sync_offsets = (control_offset, control_offset + lane_stride)
+        self._control_offset = control_offset
+        self._one_offset = control_offset + 2 * lane_stride
+        one_addr = local_base + self._one_offset

+            tuple(
+                CopyChunk(t + off + rank * _U32, one_addr, _U32) for t in self.targets
+            )
+            for off in sync_offsets
+        )
+        # Per channel: wait for every lane (this rank's included) to read 1,
+        # then clear them all; batch ops execute in array order.
+        self._ops = tuple(
+            self._wait_then_clear_ops(local_base + off) for off in sync_offsets
+        )
+
+    def _wait_then_clear_ops(self, lanes_addr: int):
+        waits, clears = [], []
+        for peer in range(self.world_size):
+            wait, clear = cu.CUstreamBatchMemOpParams(), cu.CUstreamBatchMemOpParams()
+            wait.operation = cu.CUstreamBatchMemOpType.CU_STREAM_MEM_OP_WAIT_VALUE_32
+            wait.waitValue.address = lanes_addr + peer * _U32
+            wait.waitValue.value = 1
+            wait.waitValue.flags = cu.CUstreamWaitValue_flags.CU_STREAM_WAIT_VALUE_EQ
+            clear.operation = cu.CUstreamBatchMemOpType.CU_STREAM_MEM_OP_WRITE_VALUE_32
+            clear.writeValue.address = lanes_addr + peer * _U32
+            clear.writeValue.value = 0
+            clear.writeValue.flags = (
+                cu.CUstreamWriteValue_flags.CU_STREAM_WRITE_VALUE_DEFAULT
+            )

+            clears.append(clear)

+
+    def init_control(self, window: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Zero this rank's control region and set its constant 1, given a
+        uint8 view of the whole window."""
+        start = self._control_offset
+        window[start : start + control_bytes(self.world_size)].zero_()
+        window[self._one_offset : self._one_offset + _U32].view(torch.int32).fill_(1)
+
+    def signal(self, channel: int, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        """Set this rank's lane of ``channel`` on every rank."""
+        for copy in self._signals[channel]:
+            copy(stream)
+
+    def wait_lanes(self, channel: int, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        """Wait until every rank's lane of ``channel`` is set, then clear
+        them."""
+        ops = self._ops[channel]
+        check_drv(
+            cu.cuStreamBatchMemOp(stream.cuda_stream, len(ops), ops, 0),
+            "barrier wait+clear (cuStreamBatchMemOp)",
+        )
+
+    def entry(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        self.signal(0, stream)
+        self.wait_lanes(0, stream)
+
+    def exit_signal(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        self.signal(1, stream)
+
+    def exit_wait(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream) -> None:
+        self.wait_lanes(1, stream)

+class _SymmetricTransfer:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        barrier: WindowBarrier,
+        *,
+        chunk_bytes: Optional[int],
+        chain: TransferChain,
+    ):
+        assert chunk_bytes is None or chunk_bytes > 0
+        assert chain.link is None or chunk_bytes is not None, "gates need chunks"
+        self.barrier = barrier
+        self.chunk_bytes = chunk_bytes
+        self.chain = chain
+        # The ticket of the last transfer, issued and its exit not yet waited
+        # for on this rank.
+        self._unconsumed: Optional[int] = None
+
+    @property
+    def local_base(self) -> int:
+        return self.barrier.local_base
+
+    def _push_chunks(self, src: int, dst_offset: int, nbytes: int) -> List[CopyChunk]:
+        """Chunks of one push of ``nbytes`` at ``src`` to ``dst_offset`` on
+        every rank."""
+        barrier = self.barrier
+        spans = chunk_spans(nbytes, self.chunk_bytes)
+        if not barrier.unicast:
+            (target,) = barrier.targets
+            return [
+                CopyChunk(target + dst_offset + off, src + off, n) for off, n in spans
+            ]
+        # One chunk per (span, peer), so a pause lands within one chunk_bytes
+        # copy. Peers rotate from rank + 1: at any step every rank pushes to a
+        # different peer, not all into one (NCCL's CE allgather does the
+        # same). This rank comes last, and not at all when ``src`` already is
+        # the destination.
+        rank, world_size = barrier.rank, barrier.world_size
+        peers = [(rank + i) % world_size for i in range(1, world_size + 1)]
+        if src == barrier.local_base + dst_offset:
+            peers.pop()
+        return [
+            CopyChunk(barrier.targets[peer] + dst_offset + off, src + off, n)
+            for off, n in spans
+            for peer in peers
+        ]
+
+    def _run(self, ops, after, setup) -> int:
+        if self._unconsumed is not None:
+            # The lanes must be clear before any rank can signal this
+            # transfer's exit. Through wait(): the exit wait counts this
+            # rank's own signal, and a stream must not wait on work that its
+            # chain has not enqueued yet.
+            self.wait(after, self._unconsumed)
+        barrier = self.barrier
+        self._unconsumed = self.chain.run(
+            ops,
+            setup=(*setup, barrier.entry),
+            finish=(barrier.exit_signal,),
+            after=after,
+        )
+        return self._unconsumed
+
+    def wait(self, stream: torch.cuda.Stream, ticket: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+        """Make ``stream`` wait until a transfer has landed on every rank:
+        the one of ``ticket``, or the last one. The exit barrier is waited
+        for once per transfer; a repeated wait, or one for a transfer older
+        than the last, only waits on its ticket, so it must come on a stream
+        ordered after the first wait (the same stream, typically)."""
+        self.chain.wait(ticket, stream=stream)
+        if self._unconsumed is not None and ticket in (None, self._unconsumed):
+            self.barrier.exit_wait(stream)
+            self._unconsumed = None
+

+        this rank's slot of the window. ``src_ptr`` may be that slot's own
+        local address (in place).

+        ops: List[ChunkOp] = []

+def window_targets(
+    comm, buffer: SymmetricWindowBuffer, mode: str

+    """The barrier / push targets of ``buffer``'s window for ``mode``
+    (``"multicast"`` or ``"unicast"``), or None if this rank cannot reach
+    every rank of ``comm`` that way. Collective over ``comm``; call it before
+    anything is written to the window. Callers must still agree across ranks
+    (e.g. a MIN all-reduce)."""
+    nccl = comm.nccl
+    usable = buffer.window is not None and nccl.has_function("ncclGetPeerDevicePointer")
+    # NULL for a rank outside this rank's LSA team, which the multicast team
+    # spans too (NCCL_LSA_TEAM_SIZE, multi-node, a split NVLink domain).
+    bases = [
+        (nccl.ncclGetPeerDevicePointer(buffer.window, 0, peer) or 0) if usable else 0
+        for peer in range(comm.world_size)
+    ]

+        if all(bases) and buffer.multicast_ptr:
+            return (buffer.multicast_ptr,)

+    # local VA lets an in-place push skip this rank.
+    bases[comm.rank] = buffer.tensor.data_ptr()

+def _lsa_bases_map_ranks(comm, window: torch.Tensor, bases: List[int]) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``bases[r]`` reaches rank r's window for every rank (the LSA
+    team is the whole communicator, in rank order). Every rank stamps the
+    first word of its window, then reads every rank's stamp through the
+    bases; the window is zeroed again. Collective over ``comm``."""
+    stamp = window[:_U32].view(torch.int32)
+    stamp.fill_(comm.rank + 1)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(window.device)
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=comm.group)
+    seen = torch.zeros(comm.world_size, dtype=torch.int32).pin_memory()
+    if all(bases):
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(window.device)
+        for peer, base in enumerate(bases):
+            check_drv(
+                cu.cuMemcpyAsync(
+                    seen.data_ptr() + peer * _U32, base, _U32, stream.cuda_stream
+                ),
+                "LSA probe (cuMemcpyAsync)",
+            )
+        stream.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=comm.group)
+    stamp.zero_()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(window.device)
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=comm.group)
+    return seen.tolist() == list(range(1, comm.world_size + 1))

+- CPU: foreground bracket bookkeeping over fake gates (nesting, link and
+  device filtering, one owner thread kept until the resume is enqueued,
+  exception-safe entry and exit, the in-flight skip) and the watchdog's
+  sampling.

+  pinned H2D, D2H), dedicated streams that outlive torch's host copies, a
+  held first chunk, the one-chunk drain bound (within a run, across runs,
+  with the pause landing mid-copy), chunks raising on either stream, the
+  bracket's link filter and ``wait`` guard on real gates, the capture refusal,
+  and the watchdog forcing a stuck gate open.

+  callables, and a paused root holding every rank.

+wait holds its stream's hardware queue, and any stream may share it (the

+class _HostWord:
+    """A pinned int32 that a stream can wait on (UVA: the host pointer is the
+    device address) and the host can flip without any GPU queue."""
+
+    live = []  # set to 1 by _release_parked_work
+
+    def __init__(self, value=0):
+        self.tensor = torch.full((1,), value, dtype=torch.int32).pin_memory()
+        self.address = self.tensor.data_ptr()
+        _HostWord.live.append(self)
+
+    def set(self, value):
+        self.tensor[0] = value
+
+    def value(self):
+        return int(self.tensor[0])
+
+
+class _Blocked:
+    """A chunk op held until the host releases a word. It first sets
+    ``reached``, so the host can tell the stream got past the chunk's gate."""
+
+    def __init__(self, op, word):
+        self.op, self.word = op, word
+        self.reached = _HostWord()
+
+    def __call__(self, stream):
+        cu, handle = gated_transfer.cu, stream.cuda_stream
+        check_drv(cu.cuStreamWriteValue32(handle, self.reached.address, 1, 0), "marker")
+        check_drv(
+            cu.cuStreamWaitValue32(handle, self.word.address, 1, _WAIT_EQ), "blocker"
+        )
+        self.op(stream)
+
+    def wait_reached(self):
+        assert _wait_until(lambda: int(self.reached.tensor[0]) == 1)
+
+
+def _mark(word):
+    """An op that sets ``word`` to 1 from the GPU, in stream order."""
+    return lambda stream: check_drv(
+        gated_transfer.cu.cuStreamWriteValue32(stream.cuda_stream, word.address, 1, 0),
+        "mark",
+    )
+
+
+def _release_parked_work():
+    """A failed check must not leave GPU work parked: a later device sync
+    would wait for it and hang every test after it."""
+    for gate in gated_transfer._gates:
+        gate.force_open()
+    while _HostWord.live:
+        _HostWord.live.pop().set(1)
+
+
+def _hold(stream, word):
+    """Hold ``stream`` until the host sets ``word`` to 1."""
+    check_drv(
+        gated_transfer.cu.cuStreamWaitValue32(
+            stream.cuda_stream, word.address, 1, _WAIT_EQ
+        ),
+        "hold",
+    )
+

+def _landed(host, chunk):
+    """Nonzero bytes of every ``chunk`` of a pinned host buffer."""
+    return [
+        int(host[i : i + chunk].count_nonzero()) for i in range(0, host.numel(), chunk)
+    ]
+
+
+def _wait_until(predicate, timeout=10.0):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while not predicate():
+        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
+            return False
+        time.sleep(0.005)
+    return True

+            "blocker",
+        )
+        first(stream)
+
+    ops[0] = held
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    landed = chain.run(ops)
+    pauses = gate._seq
+    y = group.all_reduce(x.clone())
+    assert gate._seq == pauses + 1, f"[rank {rank}] the all-reduce did not pause"
+    assert gate._pause_thread is None
+    blocker[0] = 1  # host only: nothing waits on the GPU before the release
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+    while not chain.query(landed):
+        assert time.monotonic() < deadline, f"[rank {rank}] transfer hung"
+        time.sleep(0.005)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(y, expected)
+    assert torch.equal(dst, src) and gate.word() == 0
+    # Opened by the bracket's stream-ordered resume, not a watchdog rescue.
+    assert gate.forced_opens == 0, f"[rank {rank}] the watchdog opened the gate"
+    # Drained: the next all-reduce pauses nothing.
+    group.all_reduce(x.clone())
+    assert gate._seq == pauses + 1
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier()
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(torch.cuda.device_count() < 2, "needs 2 CUDA devices")
+class TestAllReduceUnderInFlightTransferMultiGpu(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_all_reduce_pauses_an_in_flight_transfer(self):
+        mp.spawn(
+            _run_all_reduce_under_in_flight_transfer,
+            args=(_GATHER_WORLD, 29815),
+            nprocs=_GATHER_WORLD,
+            join=True,
+        )
+
+
+def _run_symmetric_mha(rank, world, port, mode, paused, expect_push, skipped):
+    # _run_mha checks the gathered prefix whichever transport runs it.
+    pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len = _run_mha(rank, world, port)
+    if not expect_push:
+        # The window cannot reach every rank this way: the pool falls back
+        # to the ungated NCCL allgather.
+        assert pool._sym_gather is None, f"[rank {rank}] {mode} did not fall back"
+        assert pool._gather_chain.link is None
+        assert "NCCL allgather" in pool._gather_transport_name()
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+        return
+    if pool._sym_gather is None:
+        if rank == 0:
+            skipped.put(f"no {mode} push on this host (NVLS or LSA reach)")
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+        return
+    assert pool._sym_gather.chain is pool._gather_chain
+    gate = pool._gather_chain._gate
+    activity = _gather_gpu_activity(pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len)
+    nccl_kernels = sorted({name for name in activity if "nccl" in name.lower()})
+    assert not nccl_kernels, f"{mode} gather launched NCCL kernels: {nccl_kernels}"
+    if not paused:
+        assert gate is None, f"[rank {rank}] the {mode} gather is gated"
+        torch.distributed.barrier()
+        return
+    # Drained: the forward's brackets no longer pause anything.
+    assert gate is not None and not gate.busy()
+
+    # A gather enqueued while one rank is paused completes on no rank until
+    # that rank resumes: every rank's read waits for it. The pause is flipped
+    # from the host: GPU work queued behind a parked gate can share its
+    # hardware queue.
+    cpu_group = get_parallel().attn_cp_group.cpu_group
+    pool.begin_shard_extend(req_to_token, torch.tensor([0]), [prefix_len], [seq_len])
+    prefix_rows = pool.translate_loc_to_scratch(req_to_token[0, :prefix_len].long())
+    expected = pool.get_key_buffer(pool.start_layer)[prefix_rows].clone()
+    slot = pool._slots[pool.start_layer % 2]
+    slot.tensors["k"].zero_()
+    # Drain the next layer's prefetch first: a paused gather would hang a
+    # device-wide sync.
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+    if rank == 0:
+        gate._word.value = 3
+    pool.begin_shard_extend(req_to_token, torch.tensor([0]), [prefix_len], [seq_len])
+    if rank == 0:
+        # Held by its own pause. A peer's chunks drain; its read then waits
+        # for this rank's copies, which no pause on the peer can help.
+        assert gate.busy()
+    got = pool.get_key_buffer(pool.start_layer)[prefix_rows]
+    read = torch.cuda.Event()
+    read.record()
+    time.sleep(0.2)
+    stalled = not read.query()
+    # Host-only barrier: a device-wide sync here would wait on rank 0's gather.
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+    if rank == 0:
+        gate.force_open()
+    read.synchronize()
+    assert stalled, f"[rank {rank}] {mode} read finished while rank 0 was paused"
+    _check(rank, f"{mode} k after resume", got, expected)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier()
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(
+    torch.cuda.device_count() < 2, "page-interleave gather needs 2 CUDA devices"
+)
+class TestPageInterleaveSymmetricGatherMultiGpu(CustomTestCase):
+    def _spawn(self, mode, port, *, paused=True, nvls=None, expect_push=True):
+        """The push transport assembles the same K/V prefix without NCCL
+        kernels; paused, a paused rank holds every rank's read until resumed.
+        A window that cannot reach every rank falls back to the NCCL gather."""
+        # The library the pool gates on, which may differ from torch's NCCL.
+        if NCCLLibrary().ncclGetRawVersion() < 22902:
+            self.skipTest("the symmetric gather scratch needs NCCL >= 2.29.2")
+        # The window needs cuMem, the multicast VA NVLS; the ranks inherit
+        # both. Unicast runs with NVLS off, as the engine sets it.
+        if nvls is None:
+            nvls = mode == "multicast"
+        skipped = mp.get_context("spawn").SimpleQueue()
+        with (
+            temp_set_env(
+                NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE="1",
+                NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=str(int(nvls)),
+                NCCL_CTA_POLICY=None,
+            ),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER.override(True),
+            envs.SGLANG_KV_SHARD_GATHER_TRANSPORT.override(mode),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_GATHER_PAUSE.override(paused),
+        ):
+            mp.spawn(
+                _run_symmetric_mha,
+                args=(_GATHER_WORLD, port, mode, paused, expect_push, skipped),
+                nprocs=_GATHER_WORLD,
+                join=True,
+            )
+        if not skipped.empty():
+            self.skipTest(skipped.get())
+
+    def test_pausable_multicast_gather(self):
+        self._spawn("multicast", 29813)
+
+    def test_pausable_unicast_gather(self):
+        self._spawn("unicast", 29814)
+
+    def test_ungated_unicast_gather(self):
+        self._spawn("unicast", 29816, paused=False)
+
+    def test_multicast_without_nvls_falls_back(self):
+        self._spawn("multicast", 29817, nvls=False, expect_push=False)
+
+

 # Indexer: packed FP8 keys and FP32 scales over real NCCL (2 and 4 GPUs).
